APPROVED_WORK_PACKAGE.ENGINEERING_OBJECTIVE: Recover the inherited multi-site Ansible fleet automation as a supported, portable and convergent production configuration system while preserving its production-scale topology and contracts.

inputs.DIFFICULTY_EVIDENCE: Failures are layered and ordered: controller/bootstrap and discovery can mask role/orchestration/schema/Vault/template/data/convergence issues across a three-site production-like fleet.

outputs.DIFFICULTY_EXPLANATION: The system requires iterative execution-driven diagnosis across coupled controller, discovery, orchestration, secret, schema, template/network and convergence boundaries rather than isolated file edits.
outputs.SOLUTION_EXPLANATION: The README describes restoring the supported Ansible/project bootstrap first, then portable role orchestration, Vault handling, native Ansible task schemas, heterogeneous data/IPv6 rendering, preservation, and convergence.
outputs.VERIFICATION_EXPLANATION: The README explains independent structural/behavioral verification, semantic validation, production-input preservation and unchanged second-run idempotency without exposing private test rows.
